scope: Observability only: retain a fixed failure category and optional HTTP status in timings.imageCdnLastFailure. Keep current range parallelism,30s shared transfer deadline, peer cancellation, byte/hash verification, single origin fallback and Docker identity gate. No raw upstream message, URL, header, body or credential is retained in launch telemetry.
coverage: HTTP statuses, wrong offsets/totals/lengths, incomplete/oversized bodies, hash failures and generic transfer failures produce distinct fixed categories.
A non-first rejected range retains its HTTP503 cause even when earlier-index peers abort.
Timeout category survives peer cancellation and cleanup.
Serial CDN timeout/storage/HTTP/size/integrity/generic failures preserve one authorized origin fallback and verify exact bytes before load.
Server callback accepts only enumerated reasons and integer HTTP100..599; unknown fields, signed URLs, arbitrary strings and invalid statuses are dropped.
All existing launcher, provider, build, browser, database and isolation checks pass on both platforms.
